test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 30 men can complete a work in 10 days. They started working and after six days, 10 more men joined them. In how many days will the total work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

30 men can complete the work in 10 days.

After 6 days, 10 more men join.

**Formula used:**

Total work = Men × Days

**Calculation:**

Total work = 30 × 10 = 300 man-days

Work done in 6 days = 30 × 6 = 180 man-days

Remaining work = 300 - 180 = 120 man-days

After 10 more men join, total men = 30 + 10 = 40

Remaining days = 120 / 40 = 3 days

**∴ Total time to complete the work = 6 + 3 = 9 days.**
